_about: Band-diagram fixtures, shared by the JS reader tests and by
tests/test_band_fixtures.py, which runs every one through the server's
Two properties every entry must keep, both checked by that Python test:
1. it passes _band_payload -- so a reader can never again be tested on a
shape the server does not send;
2. it is NON-SQUARE: len(bands) (the k-points) != len(bands[0]) (the
bands). A square fixture is read the same way [k][band] or [band][k],
which is how both readers shipped transposed with green tests.
Orientation is the wire's: bands[k][band]. The server stores it that way --
pc_solve.solve_pc builds one vector of n_bands per k-point, and
_band_payload pins len(k_points) == len(bands) -- so the outer index is the
k-point and the inner index is the band number.
